newsitem.title: USA: Arnold Palmer Golf names Nichols CEO.
newsitem.headline: Arnold Palmer Golf names Nichols CEO.

text.p: The Arnold Palmer Golf Co said Thursday that it named George Nichols, formerly president and chief operating officer, chairman and chief executive officer.
Roger Helms, formerly senior vice president of operations, has been named president and COO.

Nichols replaces John Lupton, who remains chairman of the board's executive committee. Company namesake Arnold Palmer will remain on the board and continue to play an active role in product development and marketing.
Nichols joined the company in November 1995. Previously, he served as chairman of Square Two Golf Inc in Fairfield, N.J. from May 1991 through October 1995.
Helms joined the company in January after serving for six years as senior vice president of operations and finance for David-Geoffrey & Associates/Slazenger Golf, USA.
